description: Guided opt-out for ZoomInfo, which lists people by email address. One opt-out covers every saved email address.
instructions: Otwórz https://privacy.zoominfo.com/, look up {full_name} with your employer, choose the listing and ask for it to be removed. Verify with each work email ZoomInfo asks about. Your saved addresses: {all_emails}. Następnie naciśnij „Zrobione”.
